note: Findost Postgres database (DB_NAME in findost_be). Built from migrations/*.sql and the Sequelize models in src/models by scripts/findost-schema.cjs.

tables.name: ap_sips
tables.note: SIPs an AP / DRA registered for their clients through POST /orders/ap/sips. One row per SIP line. FinZoom has no "list my SIPs" endpoint, so this table is what the My SIPs tab lists; status is refreshed whenever GET /orders/ap/sips/:refId is polled.

tables.name: app_banners
tables.note: knowledge centre promotional banners for app (carousel, popup, product image)

tables.name: audit_logs
tables.note: every action an ADMIN / SUPERADMIN performs. source = 'api' → written server-side by activityLogger middleware for every authenticated API call (create / update / delete / view). source = 'ui' → sent by the admin panel via POST /api/v1/activity-logs (button clicks, page views, tab switches, exports, ...). Read by GET /api/v1/superadmin/audit-log. CREATE + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS so this is safe w

tables.name: channels
tables.note: DRA social media channels

tables.name: client_notification_groups
tables.note: Targeted groups (a campaign can target 0..N groups; individual UCCs live only on the recipients table since they don't need a separate join row)

tables.name: client_notification_recipients
tables.note: Per-client fan-out — one row per (notification, client), even if the client was reachable via more than one targeted group or both individually and via a group.

tables.name: client_notifications
tables.note: Campaign

tables.name: ekyc_webhook_logs
tables.note: stores every DRA onboarding webhook event received from the ekyc system

tables.name: findost_otps
tables.note: stores OTPs for login / password reset

tables.name: findost_sessions
tables.note: stores refresh token sessions per user

tables.name: group_clients
tables.note: Group ↔ Client junction

tables.name: groups
tables.note: Groups

tables.name: knowledge_banners

tables.name: knowledge_blogs
tables.note: articles/blogs with optional cover image on S3

tables.name: knowledge_events

tables.name: knowledge_forms

tables.name: knowledge_test_attempts

tables.name: knowledge_tests

tables.name: knowledge_video_views

tables.name: knowledge_videos

tables.name: partner_group_members

tables.name: partner_notification_recipients

tables.note: Campaign

tables.name: podcast_audios

tables.name: push_notifications

tables.name: push_tokens

tables.name: recording_logs
tables.note: tracks user-triggered events (share / download_pdf / speed_event) against a podcast audio, captured from the public web/app client. No auth required to write, so device/browser/location fields are best-effort client-reported data; device_ip is captured server-side from the request.

tables.name: tickets
tables.note: support tickets raised by AP/DRA, synced with Freshdesk
